observations.finding: 32/50 pathways significant at q<0.05; strongest up: ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD 1.31, q=0.0), IL6_JAK_STAT3 (SMD 1.30, q=0.0), INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE (SMD 1.10, q=0.0), COMPLEMENT (SMD 0.91, q=4e-05); down: HEME_METABOLISM (SMD -0.95, q=2.5e-05).
No gene significant after BH (0/22, min q=0.124). BAP1 enriched (23% vs 3.6%, OR 7.88, 95% CI 1.65-37.6, nominal p=0.006) but not significant after adjustment.

16/49 continuous features significant; CDKN2A lower (delta -0.44, q=0.018), chr9p lower (delta -0.41, q=0.018), VHL higher (delta 0.41, q=0.018). Gain/loss: CDKN2A loss enriched (39.6% vs 10.9%, OR 5.35, q=0.018) and chr14q loss enriched (56% vs 27%, OR 3.43, q=0.041).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Strong, coherent RNA inflammatory/immune-activation signal with multiple q=0 pathways. CNV shows a coherent pattern of CDKN2A/9p loss with VHL gain. WXS is directionally suggestive for BAP1 but not significant after adjustment.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0001 shows a robust inflammatory/immune-activated transcriptional program accompanied by CDKN2A/9p loss and VHL gain, consistent with a biologically distinct ccRCC subgroup; BAP1 enrichment is suggestive but not statistically robust.
limitations: WXS findings not significant after multiple-testing correction.
Pathway scores are relative to the rest of the partition.

observations.finding: 14/50 pathways significant; top up: PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (SMD 1.09, q=0.0002), FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM (SMD 0.62, q=0.028), ADIPOGENESIS (SMD 0.60, q=0.028); down: ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (SMD -0.68, q=0.007), IL6_JAK_STAT3 (SMD -0.62, q=0.007), INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE (SMD -0.52, q=0.023).
PBRM1 significantly enriched (64.7% vs 24.6%, OR 5.61, 95% CI 2.30-13.7, q=0.0039). VHL enriched (70.6% vs 46.4%, OR 2.78, nominal p=0.023, q=0.248). BAP1 depleted (5.9% vs 15.9%, q=1.0).

14/49 continuous features significant; VHL, SETD2, PBRM1, chr16p, BAP1 all lower in set (delta ~ -0.45 to -0.48, q=0.005). Gain/loss: chr14q loss depleted (20.6% vs 50.7%, OR 0.25, q=0.050), CDKN2A loss depleted (8.8% vs 31.9%, q=0.099).

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Coherent multi-modal signal: PBRM1 mutation enrichment with VHL mutation enrichment, low inflammatory RNA program, and depletion of chr14q/CDKN2A loss. PBRM1 is the only WXS finding significant after adjustment.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: C0002 is characterized by PBRM1-mutant, VHL-mutant ccRCC with a non-inflammatory, metabolic (fatty-acid/adipogenesis) transcriptional profile and fewer copy-number losses, consistent with a biologically coherent subgroup.
limitations: VHL and CNV gain/loss findings are not significant after adjustment.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: A significant technical association with tissue source site (CJ) is present for C0001, though Cramer's V is modest (0.233) and below the project warning threshold (0.5).

actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multimodal identity evidence (strong inflammatory/immune RNA program with CDKN2A/9p loss and VHL gain), cross-modal membership support with high resampling stability (ARI 0.79) and positive boundary separation to both other sets, and no significant technical confounding (Cramer's V 0.233 below warning threshold). The partition shows near-zero overlap with stage/grade labels. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent PBRM1-mutant, VHL-mutant, non-inflammatory metabolic profile with significant PBRM1 enrichment, cross-modal membership support (3/4 modalities positive) and positive boundary separation to both other sets, and no significant technical confounding. Moderate internal stability (ARI 0.59) is a limitation but not disqualifying. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0003 has a coherent PBRM1/VHL-depleted identity with significant PBRM1 depletion and chr1p loss enrichment, positive boundary separation to both other sets, and no significant technical confounding. Cross-modal coherence is weaker (WSI/CNV silhouettes slightly negative, low resampling ARI 0.35) and the set is small, so uncertainty remains, but the evidence is sufficient to retain this candidate for downstream validation rather than drop it.
